newsitem.title: USA: US budget amendment vote too close to call-Daschle.
newsitem.headline: US budget amendment vote too close to call-Daschle.

text.p: Senate Democratic Leader Tom Daschle said Thursday a vote on the balanced budget amendment to the U.S. Constitution was currently too close to call.
"I still expect the vote on the balanced budget amendment to be very, very close. At this point, it's too close to call," Daschle of South Dakota said in a statement.

He issued the statement following Sen. Tim Johnson's announcement that he would refuse to support a balanced budget amendment unless it included an exemption for Social Security. Johnson is also a Democrat from South Dakota.
"I share his belief that the version of the amendment now before the Senate does not do enough to protect the Social Security trust funds against misuse," Daschle said.
